The words चित्य and ग्निचित्य are also irregularly formed.

Terms: Irregular

The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes in all tenses when used with the words यच्च and यत्र and the sense implied is that of 'wonder'.

Terms: लिङ्
The affixes meaning 'accomplished' etc. पन्थो ण नित्यम्

are necessarily elided after the word वर्षा forming a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) when it refers to being endowed with reason.

Terms:

A stem (formed by an affix or an augment or substitute) having an indicatory च् gets acute on the end syllable.

Terms: accent

The final word of चिति is lengthened before the affix कप्।

Terms: संहिता Lengthening
